lastItems.title: Separating signal from noise in coding evaluations
lastItems.summary: A new analysis from OpenAI reveals issues in SWE-Bench Pro, a popular coding benchmark, raising concerns about reliability and accuracy in evaluating AI models.

lastItems.title: Expanding Managed Agents in Gemini API:  background tasks, remote MCP and more
lastItems.summary: We’re announcing new capabilities in Managed Agents in Gemini API so developers can build reliable, production-ready agents.

lastItems.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
lastItems.summary: Gemma 4 is now significantly faster in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon via multi-token prediction (MTP), powered by MLX. Performance is now up to 90% faster when used with coding agents, as measured using the Aider polyglot benchmark.
